# NewsletterStack

Verified, date-stamped information and free tools for newsletter creators:
platform cost comparison, affiliate program terms decoded, and migration guides.

Publisher: William Robertsson (individual), Sweden. No cookies, no analytics, no tracking.

## Tools

- [Cost & affiliate earnings calculator](https://cmorewilliam123-arch.github.io/newsletterstack/calculator.html):
  compares Kit, beehiiv, MailerLite and Systeme.io at a given subscriber count; models affiliate
  earnings from explicit user-entered assumptions. All data date-stamped with primary sources.

## Reference pages

- [Editorial method & verification policy](https://cmorewilliam123-arch.github.io/newsletterstack/method.html):
  primary-source-only policy, verification dates, corrections process.
- [About](https://cmorewilliam123-arch.github.io/newsletterstack/about.html): who runs the site and how it is funded.
- [Privacy](https://cmorewilliam123-arch.github.io/newsletterstack/privacy.html): no cookies, no tracking.
- [Terms](https://cmorewilliam123-arch.github.io/newsletterstack/terms.html): information, not advice.

## Data verification

Volatile facts (prices, commission terms, plan limits) are verified against vendor primary pages
and re-checked quarterly. Current verification date: 2026-09-04.
